questions.prompt: Number of bookcases available:
questions.explanation: Người bán hàng cho biết: 'We've sold one, but we still have two available.'

questions.prompt: Width of bookcases:
questions.explanation: Người bán hàng nói rõ kích thước: 'They're both 75 cm wide.'

questions.prompt: Height of bookcases:
questions.explanation: Người bán hàng tiếp tục cho biết chiều cao: 'and 180 cm high.'

questions.prompt: Material of the first bookcase:
questions.explanation: Khách hàng muốn tìm tủ làm bằng gỗ: 'something made of wood'.

questions.prompt: Price of the first bookcase:
questions.explanation: Người bán cho biết giá của chiếc thứ nhất: 'It's just 15 pounds.'

questions.prompt: Colour of the second bookcase:
questions.explanation: Người bán miêu tả màu sắc chiếc thứ hai: 'natural wood colour, dark brown'.

questions.prompt: Age/period of the second bookcase:
questions.explanation: Người bán đề cập thời điểm mua: 'sometime in the 1930s'.

questions.prompt: Feature included at the bottom of the second bookcase:
questions.explanation: Mô tả chi tiết: 'it also has a cupboard at the bottom'.

questions.prompt: Price of the second bookcase:
questions.explanation: Giá của chiếc thứ hai được báo là: '95 pounds'.

questions.prompt: Customer's address:
questions.explanation: Khách hàng đọc địa chỉ: '41 Oak Rise, that's in Stanton'.

questions.prompt: Name of the upcoming charity event organized by Neil Curtis:
questions.explanation: Neil Curtis giới thiệu: 'the charity art sale organized this year by Neil Curtis'.

questions.prompt: Main venue for displaying the pictures:
questions.explanation: Địa điểm trưng bày chính: 'Most of them at the Star Gallery in the shopping mall'.

questions.prompt: Alternative display location for some pictures:
questions.explanation: Địa điểm phụ: 'some in the cafe next door'.

questions.prompt: Day of the week when the actual sale takes place:
questions.explanation: Thời gian bán đấu giá/bán tranh: 'The actual sale will take place on Thursday evening'.

questions.prompt: Time when the sale event starts:
questions.explanation: Giờ bắt đầu sale: 'with sales starting at 7:30'.

questions.prompt: Time when refreshments and general viewing start:
questions.explanation: Giờ bắt đầu refreshments/xem trước: 'starting at 6:30'.

questions.prompt: Total number of works contributed by local artists:
questions.explanation: Số lượng tác phẩm: 'We've got about 50 works by local artists'.

questions.prompt: Destination of all proceeds from the sale:
questions.explanation: Mục đích từ thiện: 'all proceeds will go to support children who are disabled'.

questions.prompt: Accepted payment methods include checks, cash, and ___________.
questions.explanation: Hình thức thanh toán: 'We accept checks, credit cards, or cash'.

questions.prompt: Donations are also welcome even without buying a picture; visitors can make a ___________.
questions.explanation: Khuyến khích đóng góp: 'you can always make a donation'.

questions.prompt: Author chosen by Joey:
questions.explanation: Joey chọn tác giả: 'I'm going to do Carlos Castaneda'.

questions.prompt: Author chosen by Olivia:
questions.explanation: Olivia chọn tác giả: 'So I chose Emily Bronte'.

questions.prompt: Minimum length required for the author's biography:
questions.explanation: Yêu cầu về độ dài tiểu sử: 'I think the minimum length's 250 pages'.

questions.prompt: The specific book Olivia chose to read by her author:
questions.explanation: Tác phẩm Olivia chọn: 'I'm going to do Wuthering Heights'.

questions.prompt: Maximum duration allowed for the video project:
questions.explanation: Thời lượng video: 'A minute'.

questions.prompt: Key element used to create the appropriate atmosphere in the video:
questions.explanation: Cách tạo bầu không khí: 'use things like sound effects to create the atmosphere'.

questions.prompt: Software requirement: students must use a ___________ of software programs.
questions.explanation: Yêu cầu phần mềm: 'it's important that we use a range, not just one software program'.

questions.prompt: Final requirement for the video: include a ___________ at the end listing all sources.
questions.explanation: Yêu cầu cuối video: 'with details of the source in a bibliography at the end'.

questions.prompt: Assessment criterion representing how well the essence of the work is captured:
questions.explanation: Tiêu chí đánh giá nội dung: 'how successful we are at getting the essence of the work... they call that content'.

questions.prompt: Percentage of marks allocated to the video itself (artistic and technical side):
questions.explanation: Tỷ lệ điểm video: 'the last 25% is on the video itself, the artistic and technical side'.

questions.prompt: Early research on children in the USA suggested that being bilingual ___________ learning.
questions.explanation: Bài nghe đề cập: 'early research done with children in the USA in fact suggested that being bilingual interfered in some way with learning'.

questions.prompt: Early research failed to consider children's social and ___________ backgrounds.
questions.explanation: Giải thích lý do nghiên cứu cũ không chính xác: 'it didn't take into account other factors such as the children's social and economic backgrounds'.

questions.prompt: Current understanding shows that the relationship between bilingualism and cognitive development is ___________.
questions.explanation: Nhận định hiện tại: 'we believe now that the relationship between bilingualism and cognitive development is actually a positive one'.

questions.prompt: Cognitive skills like ___________ are found to be better among bilingual children.
questions.explanation: Ví dụ về kỹ năng nhận thức: 'cognitive skills such as problem solving... are better among bilingual children than monolingual ones'.

questions.prompt: Dr Ellen Bialystok conducted studies on the effects of bilingualism at ___________ University.
questions.explanation: Nơi công tác của Dr Ellen Bialystok: 'done by Ellen Bialystok at York University in Canada'.

questions.prompt: In the experiment, subjects had to press the left or right shift key depending on the ___________ of the square.
questions.explanation: Chi tiết thí nghiệm: 'just to the color they saw... they didn't have to react at all to the actual position'.

questions.prompt: Slower reaction times caused by conflicting demands are known as the ___________ effect.
questions.explanation: Tên hiện tượng: 'because of a phenomenon known as the Simon effect'.

questions.prompt: Bilingual people were better able to deal with the Simon effect because they can suppress the activity of part of the ___________.
questions.explanation: Nguyên nhân kết quả: 'someone who speaks two languages can suppress the activity of parts of the brain when it isn't needed'.

questions.prompt: The performance gap between monolinguals and bilinguals actually ___________ with age.
questions.explanation: Kết quả theo độ tuổi: 'the performance gap between monolinguals and bilinguals actually increased with age'.

questions.prompt: Bilingualism may protect the mind against ___________.
questions.explanation: Ý nghĩa thực tế: 'bilingualism protects the mind against decline'.
